sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and verification

Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages seven to twelve, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: ages, residency windows, holding periods, license validity terms, vehicle weight and engine limits, and the named forms and visa categories are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: none; the two-column document lists on physical pages ten and eleven extracted readably, with the learner-license text and the secondary-document column interleaved but separable, and no page in the range was unreadable.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.

corpus_stability.reason: The Alabama Driver Manual is one dated edition (front cover, physical p1, prints November 2024); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
